message.reasoning: We need to answer question: "What exact date does my next invoice get generated? I need to plan around replacing my card." According to policy: The billing date is shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to “Next invoice”. Also the date is the same day of month as subscription started or last renewed. So answer: check Settings > Billing > Plan, the Next invoice date. Also mention that replacing card a day or two before is enough. So we can answer. Use policy excerpts: DOC-007 part 2 and 3, part 1. Provide instructions. So we should post reply.
